name: cai
description: Cost-tiered subagents, haiku-powered git/quick-task commands, skills for squashing a PR branch, surfacing unknowns before implementation, reviewing a plan against the requirements it claims to serve, running a parallel multi-lens review over a branch diff, and executing a long change in resumable checkpoints, a pre-merge comprehension quiz, a shared rule set installed by /cai:setup, and a shell-aware safety guard hook.
